primaryEvidence.observed: 2026-10-16 official help identifies /channel/ID as the standard unique-channel URL. Handle URLs are created when the owner chooses or changes the handle; personalized URLs are not a guarantee that the spelling never changes.
Official API guidance uses unique channel IDs, not display names/usernames, as channel identity.
Official handle guidance distinguishes handles from channel names and allows handle changes/reclamation.

anonymousResponseEvidence.method: Read-only HttpClient, UseCookies=false, no user profile/auth/credentials or media download. Exact www.youtube.com HTTPS requests only; redirect cap4/exact host; timeout12s; body cap2MiB; only bounded public identity/path/status facts projected. No response body persisted. Web tool /live fetch had cache miss; ordinary sandbox DNS failed; same authorized read-only request succeeded with normal host permissions.
anonymousResponseEvidence.limits: These prove observed public endpoint behavior, not a permanent /live service contract, future availability, or a unique selected stream when a channel has multiple simultaneous lives. Do not interpret string presence/absence of isLiveNow in full HTML as a trusted live-state observation. App must keep its existing bounded channel streams lookup and exact-video metadata check.

findings: Workspace persists kind-specific video and channel favorites with targetKey. ViewingControls passes all saved favorites through automatic.rows, so live drawer intentionally currently mixes both kinds. Its input star saves row.item; video input therefore saves the exact video, while channel input saves the channel. Creator context-menu favorite already offers a separate channel bookmark.

model.ts recognizes base channel/handle URLs and /live/VIDEO_ID, but rejects /@handle/live and /channel/UC.../live. Normalize only supported channel subpaths to the existing channel target; do not turn them into a fixed video bookmark.

ViewingControls renders two unclassified small elements; Connection.css colors every small with muted. It also has no color for the enabled automatic-record icon. CHZZK uses green #63dca8 for current live, red #ff939d plus a dot for recording, warning for a problem, and #f06f7e for an enabled reservation icon.

Existing auto snapshots describe automatic-record state. They are not comprehensive manual-record state and no new manual-record polling or cross-provider store is authorized by this presentation proposal. Cached item.isLive is a saved video classification, not current channel presence.

decision.channelQuestion: Answer that a stable unique channel-ID address exists; handle spelling can change; /live is a current-entry convenience and /streams lists broadcasts. Keep channel identity distinct from each video. Do not migrate/delete/filter existing video favorites or change existing star semantics in response to a question.
decision.urlSupport: In frontend parseYouTubeTarget, recognize exact /channel/UC[22 allowed ID chars]/live or /streams and exact existing @handle/live or /streams, with optional final slash. Normalize to the existing base channel URL/id before existing native APIs. Preserve host, protocol, credentials and port checks, reject extra path segments/encoded separators. /live/11-char-video remains a video. No backend or account navigation allowlist change.
decision.clarity: Keep the existing five-line help and fixed numbered field layout. Briefly distinguish channel addresses (follow current live) from video addresses (that one video), without a new permanent header or new help lines. Existing Explore creator context-menu channel favorite remains available. No network lookup merely for rendering or starring a saved row.
decision.presence: Use current reservation liveStatus only for green ● 방송 중 or muted 방송 종료. Unknown explicitly remains 방송 상태 미확인, not a false offline or indefinitely active loading claim. Without reservation evidence, retain a neutral channel or saved-video classification; never paint stale saved isLive as proven current live.
decision.recording: Separate second-line auto-record status from live presence. recording gets CHZZK red and a dot; failed/확인 필요 gets warning; preparation/finalization/wait/skipped/idle/off keep accurate existing wording. Enabled reservation icon gets CHZZK pressed color, but its color alone never means recording. Keep visible text/aria-pressed so state is not color-only.
decision.geometry: Retain two status lines,88px card rows, two columns/four-row scroll,30x34 action slots, star order and positions. No polling-effect dependencies, timer intervals, scheduling, playback or recording owners change.
